title: Agent Outcome Test for Agent-Facing Artifact Admissibility
summary: A Tier-2 felt-trigger at agent-facing artifact creation, parallel to ADR-083's human-facing Outcome Test: does this artifact produce direct agent consumption without re-orientation cost, or does it feel additional to the agent-facing corpus? Consumer-naming is necessary but not sufficient (trivially-passing answers fail the spirit). Graduation trigger names a candidate /rdd-conform audit step.

links.note: Tier-2 application at agent-facing artifact creation; the graduation trigger names a candidate /rdd-conform audit step
agent-facing analog of the human-facing Outcome Test; parallel, not hierarchical
both inherit the discriminating-criterion limit: a trivially-passing answer satisfies the letter of the test
one of the six prior audience-bifurcation ADRs (agent-facing admissibility)
